**Answer: No G7 countries met both criteria in 2015.**

**Female Life Expectancy at Birth (≥ 85 years) in 2015 - G7 Countries:**

Countries meeting the life expectancy criterion: **Japan, France, and Italy**.

**Countries meeting BOTH criteria:**
- **Germany**: Urban < 80% but life expectancy ~82.8 (fails)
- **Italy**: Urban < 80% AND life expectancy ~85.1 (meets BOTH!)

**Result: Only Italy fits both criteria** - urban population below 80% AND female life expectancy at birth of 85 years or more in 2015.
